categories.title: Checkpoint
categories.info: Points you can Teeleport to directly, so long as you're already in this Layer as a whole. A few are also Transition points.

categories.title: Chip Exchange
categories.info:
Exchange Banadium Chips for Banandium Gems, starting at 10 Chips and increasing by 10 for every purchase.

Note that the first Gem purchased on each layer is the only one that will count towards your collection.

categories.title: Getaway
categories.info: Speak to the Architectone to exchange gold for a getaway. Each one comes with a bed to restore health, closet for changing clothes, and gramophone to play music discs.

categories.title: Style Shop
categories.info: Style Shops let you buy and upgrade cosmetic items using the local Fossils in that layer.

categories.title: Banandium Gem
categories.info: Collecting 5 Banandium Gems allow you to upgrade DK's abilities through Skill Points.

categories.title: Clothing
categories.info: Clothing can be purchased (and sometimes upgraded) at Style Shops for fossils. They grant a wide variety of gameplay benefits.

categories.title: Fossil
categories.info: Common Fossils are used to buy the lowest-grade cosmetics at Style Shops, as well as buy their first upgrade.

locations.title: 01 - The Secret in the Solitary
locations.description:
**Location:** In a nook, halfway up the solitary confinment cell. To access:
1. Progress the story until you unlock Swap Harps
2. Teeleport to [Jail Hall](#loc=481768) and pay the nearby Constructone 500 Gold to build a Swap Harp.
3. Hit it to turn the green door golden, then smash through it and the concrete walls.
4. Hit the Swap Harp again, then head in the cell at the end of the cleared hallway and bounce off the rubber material to the gem.

locations.title: 02 - Deep under Detention
locations.description:
**Location:** In a cavern deep under the detention cell. To access:
1. Progress the story until you unlock Swap Harps
2. Teeleport to Disco Hall and pay 500 Gold to build a Swap Harp.
3. Using the Swap Harp, break through one of the two rubber blocks to the lower level, then through the the one underneath the return cannon.
4. Once on the deeper lower level, dig in the direction of [Jail Hall](#loc=481768) to reveal the gem. Be careful of the many bombs in the area.

locations.title: 03 - Banana behind Bars
locations.description: **Location:** In a cell on the 2nd level of the [Jail Hall](#loc=481768), behind a concrete door. Use Kong Bananza or a chunk of gold to break through.

locations.title: 04 - A Square-Shaped Secret
locations.description: **Location:** In a chamber hidden behind [03 - Banana behind Bars](#loc=481772). After building a [Swap Harp](#loc=491628), use one to turn the rubber block into gold and smash through to the gem.

locations.title: 05 - Smash and Receive
locations.description:
**Location:** In a secret chamber behind one of the jail cells. To access:
1. Progress the story until you unlock Swap Harps
2. Teeleport to [Jail Hall](#loc=481768) and pay the nearby Constructone 500 Gold to build a Swap Harp.
3. Head on the 1st level, then throw a chunk from the guard at the Swap Harp to turn the nearby door gold.
4. Break in the cell, and build another Swap Harp for 500 Gold. Hit it to turn the guard golden, then destroy the sign to reveal the chamber.

Alternatively, from step 2, use Snake Bananza to jump on the 1st level while the door is golden, then smash through the concrete sign.

locations.title: 06 - Gettin' Down in the Groove Layer!
locations.description: **Location:** Just before the [Disco Hall](#loc=481770) checkpoint.

locations.title: 07 - Over the Disco
locations.description: **Location:** On a platform above Disco Hall. After unlocking Swap Harps, bounce on the guard in the center of the hall to reach the gem.

locations.title: 08 - Bouncy Brainteaser
locations.description:
**Location:** Hanging from the ceiling in the jail cell. To access:
1. Progress through the story until you unlock Swap Harps. Build one in the Disco Hall for 500 Gold.
2. Destroy the gate and enter the cell with the gem. Grab a chunk of the golden pillar and set it down beside it.
3. Use a Swap Harp, then go back in the cell. Use the laid down chunk of now rubber to reach to the top of the pillar, and then the gem.

Alternatively. after breaking the gate, use Snake Bananza to immediately jump on top of the rubbery pillar.

locations.title: 09 - A Complete Fossil Collection
locations.description: **Location:** Given by the Collectone after collecting [every single Fossil in the game](https://mapgenie.io/donkey-kong-bananza/guides/fossils), alongside purchasing [every piece of clothing.](https://mapgenie.io/donkey-kong-bananza/guides/clothes)

locations.title: 10 - Destined for the Top
locations.description: **Location:** [Quest for the Top](#loc=481779) - Halfway up the course. Use Liftoff Ore to ascend, using the Swap Harps when necessary.

locations.title: 11 - Liftoff to the Top
locations.description: **Location:** [Quest for the Top](#loc=481779) - At the end of the course.

locations.title: 12 - A Groovy Disco-very
locations.description: **Location:** [Quest for the Top](#loc=481779) - Before using the exit barrel, get a chunk of mud beside it, then Swap it to Liftoff Ore. Use it to reach the disco ball above; the gem is hiding inside.

locations.title: 13 - Cranky's Groove Rant
locations.description: **Location:** Given by [Cranky Kong](#loc=481783) after listening him ramble.

locations.title: 14 - Banana Chandelier
locations.description: **Location:** On the ceiling of the VIP room, accessed by throwing a chunk of terrain at the guard outside from a distance. Once inside, bounce on a rubber Fractone to reach it.

locations.title: 15 - Groove Smashin' Stats
locations.description: **Location:** Given by the Smashinstone after smashing through 3,000 cubic meters of concrete in the layer.

locations.title: 16 - Groovin' Once Again
locations.description:
**Location:** Repair the disco hall, following these steps:
1. Throw a chunk at the disco ball above the platform to free the Groovestone.
2. Burrow through the concrete-blocked platform, then Hand Slap to bring the Groovestone up.
3. Use a Swap Harp to turn the rubber platform into gold, then break it to let the Groovestone fall.
4. Pay Grumpy Kong 20,000 Gold to repair the speakers.

locations.title: 17 - Disco Ball Destruction
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the disco ball above the Disco Hall. To access:
1. Progress the story until you unlock Swap Harps.
2. In the [Jail Hall](#loc=481768), climb to the top floor and rescue a [Fractone](#loc=491629). Either use the Swap Harp and chunk-jump all the way up, or use Snake Bananza.
3. Enter the [VIP Room](#loc=481783) and speak with the Fractone inside, who will unlock the door to the terrace.
4. Take the cannon to the gem.

locations.title: 18 - Behind the Disco's Wall
locations.description: **Location:** In a secret alcove behind the wall; break the wall where the white arrows are pointing, and make sure the nearby [Swap Harp](#loc=491627) is set to 'gold'.

locations.title: 19 - The Funky Beat Is Back
locations.description: **Location:** Appears after restoring the first source of music as part of the storyline.

locations.title: 20 - Rising Bass Line
locations.description: **Location:** In a raised alcove. Break through the dirt floor to reveal rubber beneath. Use a Dive Punch to reach the mesh and access the gem.

locations.title: 21 - Beat the Concrete
locations.description: **Location:** In the center of a concrete pillar, in the underground tunnel you dig as part of the main storyline.

locations.title: 22 - The Groovy Bass Is Back
locations.description: **Location:** Appears after restoring the second source of music as part of the main storyline.

locations.title: 23 - Lofty Melody
locations.description: **Location:** On a high ledge in a side room. Walk near the base of the room to spawn gold blocks, then Swap them to rubber to access the gem.

locations.title: 24 - A Gift from a Fan
locations.description: **Location:** Underground. After hitting a Swap Harp, keep digging until you come across an arrow-shaped Fractone with a round patch of dirt beneath it; the banana is beneath the dirt.

locations.title: 25 - The Catchy Melody Is Back
locations.description: **Location:** Appears after restoring the third source of music as part of the main storyline.

locations.title: 26 - Battle: Opposite Obliteration
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Groove Layer Battle Challenge 1](#loc=481797)

locations.title: 27 - Battle: Cliff-Wall Ambush
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Groove Layer Battle Challenge 2](#loc=481799)

locations.title: 28 - A Gift from Poppy
locations.description: **Location:** Speak with Poppy Kong on the lower level of the Disco Hall after acquiring [16 - Groovin' Once Again](#loc=481787)

locations.title: 29 - Dig the Groovy Nightlife
locations.description: **Location:** After acquiring [16 - Groovin' Once Again](#loc=481787), speak with the golden Fractone. Then, break Fractones in the crowd until you recover all 4 Fragmenstones.

locations.title: 30 - Groove Chip Exchange
locations.description: **Location:** Bought from [Chip Exchange](#loc=481803) for 40 Banandium Chips.

locations.title: Groove Layer Battle Challenge 1
locations.description:

locations.title: Groove Layer Battle Challenge 2
locations.description:

**Opponents:** 4x Wallopoid

**Reward:** [27 - Battle: Cliff-Wall Ambush](#loc=481800)

locations.title: Bombing for Gold

Bonus Stage! Gather as much gold as you can in 20 seconds!
